description.plain_text: DropShadow Gizmo This gizmo will create a drop shadow for any input image that has an alpha channel with values greater than 0. input - the input image to cast the shadow from bg - the background image the 'input' image and drop shadow will be merged over Options include: enable drop shadow - enable, or disable the drop shadow effect inherit input color - shadow color will be the same color as the input image color - color of the shadow (ignored if 'inherit input color' is active) opacity - opacity of the shadow (relative to the 'input' alpha value) angle - direction of the shadow (0/360 = left direction) distance - distance of shadow from the 'input' content position softness - amount the shadow is blurred by shrink/expand - erode(-)/dilate(+) the shadow input [merge operation] bg - operation to combine the 'input' and 'bg' inputs: 'input' => the A input 'bg' => the B input
